notes: Section 7, 1948 edition. Colour photograph cropped through the map: no frame rule on the left, top or right, and the paper (with map ink) runs to those three page edges with no background visible (checked along every side), so the outline follows the page edge there (README rule 5). Bottom: a black strip 9-13 px deep runs along the whole bottom edge of the page (first clean paper row y 6205 at the left, 6201-6202 at mid-page, 6204 at the right; the photo cuts through it, so it is either a frame bar or the background beyond the sheet); the outline lies on paper 4-6 px above it, bowed with it (rule 8), and no map ink reaches it. 'remove' (owner, 2026-11-20): three kinds of printed block are deleted wherever they sit, each drawn as a simple outline a few px outside the block's ink, on paper: the 'CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP / LEGEND' block, compass roses / north arrows, and 'SECTION N' badges. remove[0]: the title and legend block with its six swatches in the top-left corner (title lines x 305-968, y 156-464; legend x 245-1035, y 484-670), stepped at y 474 because the legend rows run wider than the title lines, 7-10 px outside the ink; on plain paper (the nearest other ink, faint dashes at x ~1066, is 24 px outside the outline and is left alone). remove[1]: the 'SECTION 7' badge (ink x 4111-4260, y 125-275), an octagon 5-6 px outside the ring, on plain paper. remove[2]: the compass rose (ink x 4300-4633, y ~425-665) with its true-north needle (tip ~4502,111), the magnetic needle with its flag (tip ~4612,165) and the long tail with its feather down to y ~1040; 16 points, more than the usual 12 so that the outline can hug the rose and the thin tail. The rose and both needle heads lie on plain paper (outline 7-15 px outside the ink). THE TAIL IS PRINTED OVER MAP INK: from y ~925 down the tail and its feather (x ~4418-4445, y ~935-1040) lie on the corner of a hatched light-industrial block and the street lines beside it. The polygon still takes the whole tail (README rule 4), as a strip ~40-60 px wide (x 4404-4466), so its last five edges (from 4428,925 round to 4466,968) cross block ink: that ink is the only ink under any outline on this sheet (ink check: 30 / 22 / 20 / 16 / 12 on those stretches, paper level ~3-5 everywhere else). The sliver of hatched block and the small block-corner knob at ~4455,955 inside the strip are removed with the tail. Not removed, inside: place names (BUENA VISTA PARK, DUBOCE PARK, MISSION PARK, DOUGLASS PLAYGROUND, BERNAL PARK), street names and block numbers. No scale bar or cross-reference note on this sheet. Doubt: among the hatching the exact end of the feather cannot be told from block ink to better than ~5 px; the strip's foot is set at y 1042, just below the last ink that reads as feather.
